integrity: Exact standalone face, modular rank, graph automorphism, signed Lefschetz and character-inner-product checks were successfully reproduced; no independent scientific audit or external certification has occurred.
limitations: One finite incidence graph; only rational homology representations are classified, not integral equivariant lattices or equivariant wedge models. The most directly relevant published Pappus calculations were compared by full text; a broader incidence-graph paper was accessible only by abstract. Unindexed equivalent results cannot be excluded.
title: Full Pappus independence-homology symmetry: irreducible dimensions four and six
